name: Salt & Pepper
description: Salt and black pepper as food seasonings, both obtained through processes that loosely mirror real life.\n\nGrow pepper vines on jungle logs, blanch the green peppercorns in a cauldron over a fire, dry them in a furnace and grind them into ground pepper. Mine rock salt ore and smelt it into salt. Season any food from any mod for a small nutrition and saturation bonus.
